prose: Altis Labs, an AI software company for drug development, has raised a $25 million Series A, CEO Felix Baldauf-Lenschen told Axios Pro. Its AI model analyzes CT scans taken during oncology trials and produces predictions tied to patient survival.
highlights: Altis Labs raised a $25M Series A.
Its model analyzes CT scans from oncology trials to produce predictions tied to patient survival.
The raise was disclosed by CEO Felix Baldauf-Lenschen to Axios Pro.
